sentences.text: The prosecution case in nutshell is that on 08.02.2024, the complainant came to the police station and made an oral report to the effect that his daughter had been kidnapped by the applicant who resides in his village.
On the basis of which, the F IR was registered at Police Station Anjad.
Thereafter, during investigation, the prosecutrix was recovered.
Her statement was also recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.PC..
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the matter.
The investigation has been completed and charge-sheet has been filed.
Therefore, no further custodial interrogation is required.
The statements of the prosecutrix and her parents under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. recorded apparently suggests that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the matter.
The applicant is permanent resident of District Badwani (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his abscission or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Trial will take time for its conclusion.
Hence, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
P e r contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

After going through the contents of the case diary and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
